title: Account Management
content:
Since there is some configuration needed for the  cloud accounts should be ordered via . The preferred CBF cloud platform is Azure but it is possible to use Google Cloud Platform as well. Primary use case for GCP will be if it concerns a function- or service which does not exist in Azure, but has the potential of adding great business benefits for IKEA. At the moment the environment is set up to allow for Test/DEV/Sandboxing activities.

If you use either Azure of GCP accounts should be ordered via CBF.


Don't forget to update .


For questions on Cloud, Cloud Strategy and Cloud Platforms, please reach out to Cloud Services at Inter IKEA CBF,

cloud.services@inter.ikea.com
